title: Round 83 (F389): Surface map classification - E roads (100x100 back tiles5c + mid wood/object1c, 2 bound) vs numbered towns/wilds (37 bound, back {1,0} + mid {15,5,10}) + 0_00x buildings (市政厅/左右翼) and kt tests ALL UNBOUND (0 bound)
objective: Classify the non-cave outdoor maps: E-series roads, numbered towns/wilds, 0_00x buildings, kt tests - by structure and bound status.
question: Which surface map families are playable (bound) and how do they differ?
method: Aggregated layer analysis of bound E + numbered maps; bound-status check for 0_00x/kt.

verdict: Surface map classification complete (primary-bytes): E roads (2 bound, 100x100 corridors) + numbered towns/wilds (37 bound, dense back {1,0} + mid {15,5,10}); 0_00x buildings (9) + kt tests all UNBOUND (never loaded by EI client).
